verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents OAuth 2.0 authentication with per-endpoint scopes and a dedicated tutorial on choosing the right scopes for an app. That lets a user issue an agent token limited to only the endpoints it needs. missing for 10: explicit docs on per-agent credential issuance and revocation or token lifetime controls, read-only versus write scope granularity details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: FreshBooks APIs use the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization
The Authorization section documents the identity model and per-endpoint scopes (with a dedicated tutorial, "How To Find The Right Scopes For Your App")
